name: Inose Kazuhiko
source: Kazuhiko is a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freeter]freeter[/url], as such he is indecisive and lives in a timely manner. He currently works at the convenience store "New Life". A while ago he and Yuriko used to date each other.
